title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student provides the correct final answer for Q in MeV.

title: Binding Energy Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly expresses the binding energy in terms of average binding energy and mass number.

title: Energy Release Expression
description: Important Criteria: The student derives the expression for Q correctly using the binding energies of the nuclei.

title: Symmetric Fission Values
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly identifies the values for A1 and A2 in symmetric fission.

title: Numerical Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student performs the numerical calculation accurately to find Q.

title: Unit Consistency

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student avoids common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of the binding energy formula.
